property: manager/agent management model survives while message processing, security, access control and application roles become explicit modular subsystems

sources.supports: RFC 3411 describes a modular SNMP engine with message-processing, security and access-control subsystems and explicitly aims to permit continued evolution of SNMP standards.

negative_claims: This edge does not claim that all SNMPv2 variants map cleanly into one linear predecessor chain.
It does not imply that SNMPv3 replaced all earlier deployed SNMP versions immediately.
open_questions: Reconstruct SNMPv2u/SNMPv2* and RFC 2571 intermediate branches before declaring the v2→v3 genealogy mature.
notes: Later endpoint is outside the core 1950s-1990s period but included to show surviving ancestry in modern management practice.
